name: WdReferenceKind
description: Specifies the information to include in a cross-reference.

constants.name: wdContentText
constants.description: Insert text value of the specified item. For example, insert text of the specified heading.

constants.name: wdNumberRelativeContext
constants.description: Insert heading or paragraph with as much of its relative position in the outline numbered list as necessary to identify the item.

constants.name: wdNumberNoContext
constants.description: Insert heading or paragraph without its relative position in the outline numbered list.

constants.name: wdNumberFullContext
constants.description: Insert complete heading or paragraph number.

constants.name: wdEntireCaption
constants.description: Insert label, number, and any additional caption of specified equation, figure, or table.

constants.name: wdOnlyLabelAndNumber
constants.description: Insert only the label and number of the specified equation, figure, or table.

constants.name: wdOnlyCaptionText
constants.description: Insert only the caption text of the specified equation, figure, or table.

constants.name: wdPageNumber
constants.description: Insert page number of specified item.

constants.name: wdPosition
constants.description: Insert the word "Above" or the word "Below" as appropriate.
